questions.question: A mixture is different from a compound because

options.a: the properties of a compound are those of its individual constituents while those of a mixture differ from its constituents
options.b: a mixture is always homogeneous while a compound is not
options.c: the constituent of a compound are chemically bound together while those of a mixture are not
options.d: a mixture can be represented by a chemical formula while a compound cannot

questions.explanation: A compound has chemically bound constituents while a mixture has physically combined constituents.

questions.question: What is the percentage of sulphur in sulphur (IV) oxide?
questions.explanation: In SO2, sulphur has a mass of 32 and oxygen has a mass of 32 (16×2), so sulphur percentage is 32/(32+32) × 100 = 50%.

questions.question: A gas X diffuses twice as fast as gas Y. If the relative molecular mass of X is 32, calculate the relative molecular mass of Y.
questions.explanation: Using Graham's law: Rate X/Rate Y = √(Molar mass Y/Molar mass X). Since X diffuses twice as fast, 2 = √(Molar mass Y/32). Squaring both sides: 4 = Molar mass Y/32, so Molar mass Y = 128.

questions.question: 200cm3 of a gas at 25⁰C exerts a pressure of 700 mmHg. Calculate its pressure if its volume increases 350 cm3 at 75⁰C.
questions.explanation: Using the combined gas law: P1V1/T1 = P2V2/T2. Converting temperatures to Kelvin: 25°C = 298K, 75°C = 348K. P2 = (700 × 200 × 348)/(298 × 350) = 467.11 mmHg.

questions.explanation: Cobalt has atomic number 27 (protons), mass number 60, so neutrons = 60-27 = 33, and electrons = protons = 27.

questions.question: 16.55g of lead (II) trioxonitrate (V) was dissolved in 100g of distilled water at 20⁰C, calculate the solubility of the solute in moldm-3 [Pb = 207, N = 14, O = 16]
questions.explanation: Molar mass of Pb(NO3)2 = 207 + 2(14 + 48) = 331g/mol. Moles = 16.55/331 = 0.05 mol. Solubility = 0.05 mol in 0.1 dm³ = 0.5 mol/dm³.

questions.question: Calculate the quantity of electricity in coulombs required to liberate 10g of copper from a copper compound [Cu=64, F = 96500 Cmol-1]
questions.explanation: Moles of Cu = 10/64 = 0.15625 mol. Cu2+ + 2e- → Cu, so 2F per mole. Electricity = 0.15625 × 2 × 96500 = 30156.3 C.

questions.question: How many faraday of electricity is required to produce 0.25 mole of copper?
questions.explanation: Cu2+ + 2e- → Cu, so 2F per mole. For 0.25 mole: 0.25 × 2 = 0.50F.

questions.question: A hydrocarbon has an empirical formula CH and a vapour density of 39. Determine its molecular formula. [C = 12, H = 1]
questions.explanation: Vapour density = 39, so molecular mass = 2 × 39 = 78. Empirical formula mass = 13. Molecular formula = (78/13) × CH = 6 × CH = C6H6.

questions.question: Cr2O72-(aq) + H2O(l) ⇌ 2CrO42-(aq) + 2H+(aq). What happens to the reaction above when the hydrogen ion concentration is increased?

options.a: more of the products will be formed
options.c: the equilibrium position will shift to the right

questions.explanation: According to Le Chatelier's principle, increasing H+ concentration will shift the equilibrium to the left to reduce the H+ concentration.
